notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello ShantyTown fans![/p][p][/p][p]A new version of the ShantyTown Demo is now available, and there are a LOT of changes that were made to enhance the experience bringing quite a few QoL features as well as updates to the game's base mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3701340/ShantyTown_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]What's Changed?[/h2][p]The main changes include:[/p][list][*][p]A new, smoother camera[/p][/*][*][p]A deck on the left side of the screen that shows all remaining objects[/p][/*][*][p]You can now swap items in a group[/p][/*][*][p]New settings and keybinds[/p][/*][*][p]Your progress will save visually when you exit and re-enter[/p][/*][*][p]Saving and loading maps improved[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations made to reduce GPU bottleneck[/p][/*][/list][p]Other changes include new objects, layouts, background systems, sounds, music, art, placement improvements, UI upgrades, QoL features and much more. There are like, 100s of things. Too many to list![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/4672dc72975d8ed58b41a09a25f0e988ab2fe81e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Any New Maps to Play?[/h2][p]At this time, I haven't yet added any NEW maps to the demo, and I think I'll keep it that way, as I like the selection of maps available. Currently, the demo is about [b]1-2 hours of gameplay[/b], depending how fast you play.[/p][p][/p][p]If you really want to play more or [b]help the development[/b] of the game, please sign up for the [b]Playtest[/b] which I've re-activated. To jump the random queue, fill out this form and we'll get you involved.

[url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeRfZsvRqLnkLIiZoqnJhH01Jtfw2DOfHWkK0Kep4V30_sdPQ/viewform" style="button"]Join the Playtest[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Playtesters will get access to different later stage areas of the game and give feedback on balance and design to help shape the overall experience of the game. If this sounds like something you'd like to do, please [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeRfZsvRqLnkLIiZoqnJhH01Jtfw2DOfHWkK0Kep4V30_sdPQ/viewform"]come join![/url]

That's all for now, until the next update![/p]

notes.title: ShantyTown Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Want to build cozy urban environments? Well, you're in the right spot. 

[h1]The ShantyTown Demo is Here![/h1]

[h2]What is ShantyTown?[/h2]
ShantyTown is a relaxing urban diorama building game with a bit of a twist. Unlike other casual creation games, ShantyTown guides you with objectives and a curated set of objects to place at each location. While you play, you'll be [b]discovering what the location is![/b] Could it be a dockside tea house, a nightlife district or seafood market?

[previewyoutube=k7todrk_8z4;full][/previewyoutube]

Jump into the first few missions of this demo and feel the vibes for yourself!

[h2]What's in the Demo?[/h2]

The ShantyTown Demo includes 5 maps including 2 major destinations and 3 minor ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/52f2d7cf15b327c8e69e1eb8938b55fc3eae0416.png[/img]The Welcome Pier: Learn how to play the game in this tutorial level

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/95cd9729d0fb4966dc3498b2854daee28412bef5.png[/img]The Shrine: Just a bit of fun in the grass before the real game starts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/d1aae4f1eea6db47875374d7a06e8ce2d272c3a8.png[/img]The Lighthouse: Stack your houses, cafes and restaurants on this tiny peninsula above the water below

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/cbf2d3783634ed1784c1b8a95dbb6772f66e1526.png[/img]Crosswaters: A stopover point for boat traffic and a hub to many other locations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/748782e38ab2a0732fb0bbd261f9802d776d5523.png[/img]Marshlands Pipe: Built into the side of a transportation tunnel, this is a nightlife district soaked in neon lights

[h2]How Can I Help?[/h2]

Want to help shape the development of ShantyTown for the better? That would be wonderful!

I'm a solo developer and I need all the help I can get.
The best way you can improve this game is to [url=https://discord.gg/HCBzgkyd5r][b]join the Discord[/b][/url] server and share your thoughts with me directly there. 

Otherwise, there's a feedback form at the end of each level. Please share your honest opinions! I'd love to hear them. 

Thanks for the support and I hope you enjoy ShantyTown!
-Dev

notes.title: Reveal Trailer
notes.notes:
I'm excited to finally share the [b]reveal trailer[/b] of [b][i]ShantyTown[/i][/b] with you!

Without further ado, here it is!

[previewyoutube=M7LLeB1RG0w;full][/previewyoutube]

Let me know what you think and share a comment either here or [url=https://youtu.be/M7LLeB1RG0w]on the video on YouTube![/url]

[b]ShantyTown [/b]has been in steady development for [b]two years[/b] now, which sounds as crazy to me as it does to you. Without being specific yet, I'm planning on a full release sometime this year!

I'm really looking forward to this next chapter of development, excited to see what you create and discover, and [b]excited for the future of ShantyTown![/b]

That's all for now, take care!
[i]-Dev[/i]

notes.title: New Playtest Map: Seafood Market
notes.notes:
[h1]New Map: Seafood Market[/h1]
Who doesn't love miscellaneous seafood? Possibly fished from a marsh? Mmm Tasty...
This is one of the intermediate locations that is not required and not even on a path to other required stops so it's totally optional. The main reward for visiting this location is seeing unique content.

[h2]Adding Music?[/h2]
That's right, I'm working on a music system in ShantyTown that adjusts based on how you're playing. Right now the only location with an available musical track is the [b]Lighthouse[/b] map, please check it out and let me know what you think!

As usual I'll also be adding a few more people to the playtest so if you get the email, welcome!
Please try it out and let me know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/8c028ae431e70bb939177f76d00a849d74ea949d.png[/img]

If you want to learn more about the playtest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2434600/view/525335573256210705]check out the event[/url].

Please share [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeYyq4kSHRUZhrxbWAMerGgtHCGD4Smk215KVInwiu1j_A_zg/viewform?usp=dialog]general feedback here[/url] and more [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScLXttIBtg5PRn-MZaB8Z6vA66MvQ1CvLQV_syVsWhZF8dZCA/viewform?usp=dialog]map specific feedback here[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVPwozadcjOLr3O3GduxenFFSvYMLZ-v9zJkJfI6I2Ov4Dfw/viewform?usp=dialog]bug reports here[/url].

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated all pages of the dossier
[*] Added music at the Lighthouse
[*] Esc now cancels placement
[*] Testing a new “rewards” system when upgrading buildings
[*] Added new "unique" items
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hopefully fixed some placement issues at Shanty Town
[/list]

Thanks for joining the playtest of [b]ShantyTown[/b]!
-Erik

notes.title: ShantyTown Playtests have Begun!
notes.notes:
Hello all!
As ShantyTown's development is in a pretty good spot, I've decided it's finally time to share the game, and more importantly, [b]get player feedback![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/c463040efe52d6d268ace166fb1426438996bf34.png[/img]

[h2]Here's the deal:[/h2]
I'm going to grant access to the [b]first 100 playtesters today![/b] Those playtesters will only have access to the first 3 maps of the game to play as much as they want.

[h3]Every couple of weeks[/h3]
I'll add a [b]few more people[/b] to the playtest alongside [b]another map[/b] to try out as well as whatever new updates come with it. I'll keep you informed with what's included in each of those updates as they come.

[h3]If you didn't get access yet?[/h3]
Don't worry, there will be plenty of chances in the future!

[h3]Want to sign up for the playtest?[/h3]
You can on the Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/

[h3]Want to wait until the game is actually done?[/h3]
Great! Just hang around and I'll let you know when it's all ready for you :)

I'm really excited for this step, and looking forward to the feedback people can provide.
Thanks and speak soon!
-Erik

notes.title: ShantyTown Devlogs!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to ShantyTown![/h1]
Are you interested in creating dense urban environments one piece at a time? Then you're in the right spot!

[h2]View the ShantyTown Devlogs[/h2]
I’ve been working on this project for about [i]a year[/i], and I’m excited to share it with you! [b]ShantyTown[/b] is a relaxing cozy game, where you will create unique, colorful, atmospheric city blocks in an unusual land.

Since the very beginning of development I've been creating [b]devlogs[/b] for ShantyTown. Here are the 2 most recent ones:

[previewyoutube=Cjq0AOD9q5w;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=6pjHmp7qnn0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hungry for more? I try to create these monthly, and plan to keep doing so. Follow the link below to view the full playlist:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwnW8-pQYvBePhb3vCX8F5VhXFYBdcPqu][b]View all ShantyTown Devlogs[/b][/url]

[h2]Sign Up for Playtesting Today![/h2]
Want to help ShantyTown reach its potential? [b]Sign up to be a playtester[/b] today on the main Steam page.

As a playtester, you'll be one of the first to try the game and it gives you an opportunity to give critical feedback to bring the project to life. It is incredibly helpful to me as a developer to know what works, what doesn't work, what is fun, and what is not. I truly appreciate every bit of constructive feedback I receive from playtesters! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/

[h2]Follow ShantyTown Updates on Discord and Bluesky[/h2]
If you haven’t already, be sure to follow Silk Softworks (my company) on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/silksoftworks.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] or join the Discord using the links below.

Stay tuned for more news!
